hypothesis: Starting from exact source endpoint428_pair_layer0_gate_dot_fuse_output_update_loop_dual112_half_horizon_v1, a frozen integer DPLR recurrent model with 112 hidden/cell states, shared rank-1/2/4 interaction channels, diagonal recurrence, and causal event embeddings can preserve score-critical recurrent information while eliminating dense forward matrices, BPTT, Adam, worker dispatch, and barriers.
kill_condition: No rank in 1/2/4 fits the counted score budget on sealed disjoint windows, integer shadow diverges between encoder and decoder, parameter package exceeds remaining margin, or measured runtime cannot approach the absolute official bound.
promotion_condition: Quantized shadow passes sealed disjoint coding-loss gates; integrated codec roundtrips and deterministically re-encodes; counted full-score forecast remains at or below 109500000; matched recurrent replacement consumes at most 1.86 percent of the old recurrent region and absolute official runtime, decimal 10GB memory, and package limits pass.
rejection_reason: Output-only rank-1/2/4 shadow screen failed before native integration. Deep rank 1 quantized holdout was 4.496/4.479 bits per byte and deep rank 4 was 4.635/4.479 versus teacher 2.444/2.124; added package 14,639/17,307 bytes. Current previous-byte event input and 64-byte reset training do not reconstruct endpoint428 recurrent state. Reconsider only with sealed hidden/cell/gate traces, continuous-state training, or richer causal features. Evidence: results/dplr112_rank1_shadow_1m_deep_v1/receipt.json and results/dplr112_rank4_shadow_1m_deep_v1/receipt.json.
title: Fixed quantized diagonal-plus-low-rank 112-state recurrent replacement
